'''Bright lights''' was a beverage served at the [[Glow Dome]] on [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]]. The [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] was expensive, and the drink cost ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a glass.<ref name="WHoSaV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bright lights was first mentioned in ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a [[1997]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Paul Danner]].<ref name="WHoSaV" />
